pb-career.title: Career desk
pb-career.intro: Keep client facts, job sources and reviewed packs together. The client sends and applies.
pb-career.legal: Live client work waits for a named lawyer's privacy review. Use fictional evidence for practice meanwhile.
pb-career.factsHelp: New claims and changed qualifiers wait for your approval. Only approved facts enter a pack.
pb-career.forbidden: Never use this fact for, one per line
pb-career.approveFact: Approve this fact and its limits
pb-career.sourcesHelp: Paste the full listing with its address. LinkedIn and Naukri stay copy and paste only.
pb-career.captureHelp: Approve this exact address. A changed, incomplete or restricted page saves nothing.
pb-career.sourceComplete: Complete saved source text. Review its meaning with the client.
pb-career.loadError: Current records could not load. Refresh before continuing.
pb-career.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This could not finish. Review the current order and try again.
pb-career.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: A lawyer must confirm the client privacy purpose and notice first. Practice uses fictional evidence.
pb-career.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The record changed. Review its current version before approving.
pb-career.error.CAREER_SOURCE_CHANGED: Facts or sources changed. Prepare and review a new pack.
pb-career.error.CAREER_CAPTURE_INCOMPLET: No job was saved. Paste the complete listing instead.
pb-career.error.FETCH_POLICY_REFUSED: This page cannot be read automatically. Paste its complete text.
pb-career.error.INVALID_VENTURE_REQUEST: Check the fields and use only confirmed information.
pb-career.packHelp: Choose approved facts and exact role evidence. Code keeps every qualifier.
pb-career.intendedUse: Intended use, or leave blank for this pack type
pb-career.pdfFallback: The browser keeps an HTML file. A PDF needs the desktop print service.
pb-career.draftLocks: Finish or clear the new evidence selection before reviewing an older pack.
pb-career.aiHelp: AI can select approved evidence. Review the exact request, model and cost before any client text leaves. Meaning and voice still need review.
pb-career.clientHelp: Create a link only after your file review. The client must approve that exact version through the link. Chausar never applies or sends a message.
pb-career.clientApproved: The client approved these exact files
pb-career.error.CAREER_CLIENT_APPROVAL_R: The client must approve these exact files through their review link.
pb-career.error.CAREER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: Review and approve the current rendered files first.
pb-career.error.CAREER_RENDER_REQUIRED: Render current review files before approving them.
pb-career.error.CAREER_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: A claim crosses a fact boundary, or a required review is incomplete.
pb-career.error.CAREER_UNSTATED_FACT: Use an approved fact from this client ledger.
pb-career.error.NO_MODEL_CONNECTED: Connect a supported AI in Your AI. No client text was sent.
pb-career.error.SHARE_NOT_HOSTED: Client review links need hosted Chausar. Keep the files local meanwhile.
pb-career.applicationsHelp: Record only an update the client has confirmed. Chausar never submits an application.
pb-career.shortlistHelp: Rate only saved listings. These are owner assessments, never a hiring promise.
pb-career.researchSaved: Research pack saved for file review
pb-career.boardHelp: Approve one public company board read. Results are an index, not complete job evidence. Capture or paste the full listing separately.
pb-career.boardIndexOnly: Index only. Read the complete listing before using it as evidence.
pb-career.error.RECRUIT_BOARD_UNAVAILABL: The public board could not be read. Paste its complete job listing.
pb-career.coachingHelp: Start with an approved client example and an exact researched fact. Score targets as assessments, then review voice before any handoff.
pb-career.scoreHelp: Seven criteria, each from zero to two. Evidence is a public HTTPS address or the explicit word guess. Code sums the scores.
pb-career.outreach: Outreach draft with your own take
pb-career.clientFactConfirmed: The client confirmed their fact and this draft
pb-career.voiceConfirmed: I reviewed the voice and context with the client
pb-career.reason.your-take-unfilled: Fill your own take before review.
pb-career.reason.researched-fact-missing: Include the exact researched fact and its source.
pb-career.reason.client-fact-missing: Include the approved client fact with every qualifier.
pb-career.reason.client-confirmation-mis: The client has not confirmed this draft.
pb-career.reason.owner-voice-review-need: Review voice and context with the client.
pb-career.pilotHelp: Use the price already set for Profile and tailoring. Agree the measure, time and reference permission. The proposal still waits for your approval on Today.
pb-career.pilotTarget: Agreed target in the client words
pb-career.pilotReference: May you name the client later?
pb-career.pilotToday: Review and approve the proposal on Today before you share it.
pb-career.error.PILOT_UNPRICED: Set a positive owner price for Profile and tailoring in the business plan first.
pb-career.error.PILOT_WINDOW: Choose two to six weeks and a measurement date inside the pilot.
pb-career.applicationManual: Client reported. The client sends and applies.
